digest: No test files, fixtures, or test script exist in the repo, so no requirement (S1–S7, C1–C2, T1–T3, Q1) has test evidence.
coverageGapsSuspected: S1: no test covers stop detection via disk intent or an aborted foreground signal for the same workflowRunPath.
S2: no test checks the WorkflowStopRequested error name or the 'workflow stop requested for <runId>' message.
S3: no test checks the 50ms default pollMs or the 10ms floor for smaller caller values.
S4: no test checks that watch-path read failures are not stops while throwIfWorkflowStopRequested propagates them.
S5: no test checks that no new disk read starts after dispose().
S6: no test checks that only the WorkflowStopRequested name counts and message content is ignored.
S7: no test checks that the unregister function removes the run entry once its last signal is released.
C1: no test checks that only aborted, AbortError, and ABORT_ERR count as cancellation while other provider errors do not.
C2: no test checks JSON text inside content arrays or the absence of infinite recursion.
T1: no test checks completed_degraded when degradation records exist.
T2: no test checks completed_without_semantic_result when direct-dynamic control.json is unreadable.
T3: no test checks that outputRetryAttempts and launchRetryAttempts sum retries across all tasks.
Q1: the spec requires a unit test for each S/C/T item, and none exists; this is itself a non-conformance with the spec.
notes: Repo has src/workflow-stop.ts, src/workflow-cancellation.ts, and src/workflow-terminal.ts, but no *.test.* or *.spec.* files and no test directory.
package.json defines only a 'typecheck' script (tsc --noEmit); there is no test runner configured.
Grep for describe/it/test/assert calls found no matches outside .agent-workflow and .git.
Git log entries reference a 'stop/cancel sample'; the workspace is a sample excerpt, and no test files appear in the working tree.
SPEC.md states store.js and types.js are excluded from this excerpt, so behaviors depending on them cannot be traced to tests here.

scopeLimitations.text: Tests were inspected but not executed because this stage is read-only and forbids commands.
Implementation and behavior of src/ were not analyzed in this stage; only test evidence was mapped.
store.js and types.js are excluded from the spec excerpt, so their behavior is outside the reviewable scope.
